**The terrain graph editor, rebuilt for composites**

The new terrain generator's graph now works at the level of Gaea and World Machine. Select nodes and press ⌘G to make a composite of them, one node that holds them; double-click it to open it, with a breadcrumb back out, its inputs and outputs as columns at the edges, and expose any setting inside so that every node of it shows it as its own. Massif's Mountain opens read only, and Edit a copy makes it the world's own. Frames take a title, a colour and a note, sit in other frames, fold to their title and move with what they hold. Nodes take a name of their own, can be bypassed (B), snap to the grid, line up and arrange themselves in columns, and copy and paste as JSON, between worlds too. Each kind of socket has its colour and shape, points, lines, footprints, instances and volumes included, and a wire an input cannot take says why and which node to put between them.
